title: A denied claim reopened through appraisal in Spring
shortStory: After a major renovation, this Spring homeowner's aging roof began to leak. We identified covered storm damage, pursued the appraisal process after an initial denial, and secured approval for a full roof replacement — managing the entire process from beginning to end.
longStory:
After investing heavily in renovating their Spring home, this homeowner discovered that the aging roof had begun to leak — threatening the work they'd just finished.

Northvale Roofing inspected the property, identified storm damage from a covered weather event, and helped reopen the insurance claim after it was initially denied. Working with an experienced appraisal team, we secured approval for a full roof replacement while handling the entire process from beginning to end.

The new roof completed the home's transformation — without creating another major financial burden.

If you need help with a denied insurance claim or a roof replacement in Spring, we're here to help.
